paite: Ehud sih nung in Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh.
heading: Debora Leh Barak
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

paite: Huchi in Hazor a vaihawmpa, huai Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin kiang ah TOUPA'N akhawngta hi. Huai mi sepaih heutupen bel Sisera ahi a, Zentelte gam Haroseth ah ateng hi.
english: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA asam uh. Huai mi in kangtalai zakua tak anei a, kum sawmnih sung Israel suante nakpitak in anuaisiah hi.
english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

paite: Huai lai in Lapidoth zi, zawlnei Deborah in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

paite: Ephraim tanggam a Ramah leh Bethel kho kikal a tum sing nuai ah Deborah ateng hi. Israel suante akiang ah avai uh hawmsak ding in ahong hoh zel uhi.
english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

paite: Kedesh Naphtali gam a pan Abinoam tapa Barak athukhak a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, Tabor Tang kiang ah hohtou inla, Naphtali suante leh Zebulun suante mi singkhat pi in.
english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

paite: Huchi in Kishon lui ah Jabin sepaih heutu Sisera, akangtalaite leh amipite toh ka hon sawl ding; amah nang ka hon pe ding, chi in thu ahon pia ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

paite: Barak in akiang ah, "Hon tonpih lechin ka hoh ding. N'on tonpih kei dingleh ka hoh kei ding," achi hi.
english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

paite: Ama'n, "K'on tonpih tham ding. Himahleh na hohna a minhoih loh lou ding na hi. TOUPA'N Sisera numei kiang ah akhawng ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in Deborah athou a, Barak toh Kedesh ah ahohta uhi.
english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

paite: Barak in Zebulunte leh Naphtalite Kedesh ah athukhakkhawm a; mi singkhat amah toh ahohtou ua; Deborah leng akiang uah ahohtou sam hi.
english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

paite: Ken mi Heber bel Mosi puzon Hobab suante lak a pan ana om tuam a, Kadesh kiang a Zaanaim gam a tosaw sing mun ah apuanin ava kai hi.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

paite: Abinoam tapa Barak bel Tabor tang ah ahohtou chih Sisera ahilh uhi.
english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

paite: Huchi in Sisera in akangtalai tengteng, sik kangtalai zakua leh aheute Zentelte gam Haroseth a pan, Kishon lui ah akaikhawm hi.
english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

paite: Huchi in Deborah in Barak kiang ah, "Khai le, tuni TOUPA'N Sisera hon piak ni ahi. Na makaipa TOUPA ahi kei a hia?" achi hi. Huchi in Barak Tabor tang a pan apaisuk a, mi singkhat in azuisuk uhi.
english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

paite: TOUPA'N Sisera leh akangtalai tengteng leh asepaih tengteng namsau in Barak ma ah ahihbuai gawpta a; akangtalai a pan Sisera akumkhia a, akhe in ataimang hi.
english: Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

paite: Barak in bel kangtalaite leh sepaihte Zentel gam Haroseth pha in adelh hi. Huchi in Sisera sepaih tengteng namsau in athat vek a; khat lel leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

paite: Sisera bel Ken mi Heber zi Jael puanin ah khe in atailut hi. Hozor Kumpipa Jabin leh Ken mi Heber inkuante kikal ah lemna a-om hi.
english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

paite: Jael bel Sisera dawn ding in ahong pawt a, akiang ah, "Pu, hong lut in, ka kiang ah hong lut in; lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in puanin sung ah akiang ah alutta a, ama'n puan in akhuh hi.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hehpih in tui tawmchik hon pe dih ve, ka dang atak mahmah hi," achi hi. Ama'n bawngnawi thawl ahong a, adawnsak a, akhuhkhum nawn hi.
english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

paite: Akiang ah, "Puanin kongpi ah ding inla, huchi in 'Hiai ah mi a-om hia?' chi a hon dot uleh, 'om lou' na chi zel in," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

paite: Heber zi Jael in puanin khetkilhna ala a, sek atawi a, awlchik in akhe asuanphei a, khetkilhna in ahaizek ah akhen paisuak a, lei toh akilhbelh hi. Bah in a-ihmut alim mahmah ngal a; huchi in asita hi.
english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

paite: Ngai in, Barak in Sisera ahon delh a, amah tuak ding in Jael ava pawt a, akiang ah, "Hong pai in, na mi zon ka hon ensak ding," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah ava hoh a; ngai in, Sisera ana sita mai a, ahaizek ah puanin khetkilhna ana tal hi.
english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in huai ni in Israel suante ma ah Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah hi.
english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

paite: Kanaan kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah masiah uh, Kanaan kumpipa Jabin tung ah Israel suante ahat semsem uhi.
english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
